usage: agentware prefer mine [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--backfill]
                             [--max-sessions MAX_SESSIONS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --backfill            one-shot historical mining of seeded sessions (bounded
                        by --max-sessions; run repeatedly to catch up).
                        Default: incremental.
  --max-sessions MAX_SESSIONS
                        cap sessions walked this run (default: 50)
